article_summaries.title: SOE Offers Double Station Cash and Double Experience Event This Weekend
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post from April 2011 says SOE, after a PlayStation Network security breach caused a service interruption, ran a Double Station Cash event on Saturday for Free Realms, EverQuest and EverQuest II. Free Realms, EverQuest and EverQuest II also got double experience through Saturday. Free Realms is a minor mention in a multi-game announcement, with no event details beyond these.
